maya (docs): Opening a compact PR with focused examples for ratecard rollouts and quota reconciliation. Draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2568 :wave:

toni (eng-platform): Thx. Two quick asks: 1) show the new header X-RW-Usage in every snippet and map the legacy header; 2) include a Grafana permalink (we use panel id 58 for the ratecard overview).

maya (docs): Will do. Current curl example in the draft:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-RW-Usage: project=widget,env=prod" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/usage?from=-24h&group_by=1h"
```

rahul (product): Make hourly the canonical example for public docs (matches billing). Add a short sentence explaining that visible allocation = committed tier + burst credits.

jin (devex): Also add a tiny JS snippet showing how body.series[].points is ordered (old confusion). Example I suggest is minimal so docs remain concise.

maya (docs): Adding this JS snippet under SDK snippets:
```
// hourly aggregation
const r = await fetch('/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1h',{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,'X-RW-Usage':'project=widget,env=prod'}});
const b = await r.json();
console.log(b.series[0].points.slice(-3));
```

toni (eng-platform): Good. One more: include a one-liner troubleshooting tip for rollouts: if you see doubled totals, check that canary/stable routes use distinct meter_key values and that routing headers were updated.

maya (docs): Adding a troubleshooting callout: "If totals look doubled after rollout, verify routing headers, unique meter_key per route, and whether both routes reported to the same meter."

rahul (product): Also call out that fallback routing to compatible model variants can change which model meter receives tokens; point readers to the per-route snapshot view to reconcile attribution. Keep it short.

maya (docs): Pushed edits: header rename + legacy mapping, Grafana panel id 58 permalink, hourly primary example + JS SDK snippet, burst credits callout, rollout troubleshooting, and fallback-meter attribution note. Tagging @toni and @rahul for review. :rocket:
